newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Surveillance sees positive trend continuing.
newsitem.headline: Surveillance sees positive trend continuing.

text.p: Swiss inspection and testing group Societe Generale de Surveillance Holding SA said it expected the positive trend seen in the first half of the year to continue if there is no major exchange rate deterioration.

"In the current environment and barring any major foreign exchange rate deterioration, this positive trend should be sustained for the remaining part of 1996," the company said in its letter to shareholders.
Surveillance also reported that its first half group net profit rose 10.9 percent to 110.9 million Swiss francs.
